answer.reason: Alaska construction employment follows a pronounced seasonal cycle: QCEW monthly covered-employment levels for NAICS 23 peak in the summer (often above 20,000) and fall to the low-to-mid teens in winter. December 2024 sits at the seasonal trough, so a private-sector construction level of roughly 13,500 covered jobs (13,566) is consistent with the known pattern, whereas 17,380 aligns more with an annual-average or peak-season level. Based on this prior knowledge of the seasonal pattern, option A is the supported choice, though the underlying CSV was not supplied for direct cell verification.
